title: Lessening Organ Dysfunction with VITamin C in septic ARDS
official: LOVIT-ARDS - A Multicentre Concealed‐Allocation Parallel‐Group Blinded Randomized Controlled Trial to Ascertain the Effect of High‐Dose Intravenous Vitamin C Compared to Placebo on Mortality or Persistent Organ Dysfunction at 28 Days in Septic ARDS Patients
summary: Main objective: To compare the effect of high-dose intravenous vitamin C vs. placebo on a composite of death or persistent organ dysfunction – defined as continued dependency on mechanical ventilation, new renal replacement therapy, or vasopressors – assessed at 28 days on ICU patients
conditions: Patient with sepsis complicated by ARDS

interventions.name: Biological Therapies Sodium Ascorbate Solution 30 g in 100 mL Injection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients ≥ 18 years old
2. Admitted to the ICU with proven or suspected infection as the main diagnosis
3. Currently treated with a continuous intravenous infusion of vasopressors (norepinephrine, epinephrine, vasopressin, dopamine, phenylephrine, angiotensin, others))
4. Currently treated with high flow oxygen, CPAP OR NIV OR Invasive Ventilation
5. Presenting with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndromedefined by all the following criteria: o Acute onset, i.e. within one week of an apparent clinical insult and with progression of respiratory syndrome o Bilateral opacities on chest imaging not explained by other pulmonary pathologies (e.g. pleural effusion, atelectasis, nodules, etc.) o No evidence for heart failure or volume overload o PaO2/FiO2 ≤ 200 mm Hg o PEEP ≥ 5 cm H2O
6. Patient who has signed an informed and written consent whenener he/she is capable of consent, if not, Patient’s representant signed consent whenever he/she is present at inclusion
7. Affiliation to a social security system or to an universal health coverage (Couverture Maladie Universelle, CMU)
8. Patients under guardianship or curatorship can be included
9. Patients in case of simple emergency (legal definition) or vital emergency will be included
Exclusion criteria:
1. 48 hours from diagnosis of ARDS
2. Received any intravenous vitamin C during this hospitalization unless incorporated in parenteral nutrition (PN) in doses standard for PN
3. Expected death or withdrawal of life-sustaining treatments within 48 hours
4. Previously enrolled in this study
5. Previously enrolled in an interventional trial for which co-enrolment is not allowed (co-enrolment to be determined case by case)
6. Patient with critical COVID-19 according WHO definition
7. Cardio-pulmonary resuscitation (CPR) in the past 72 hours
8. Known Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency
9. Pregnancy and breast-feeding
10. Hyperoxaluria
11. Known allergy excipients of vitamin C solution; or to one of the excipients in particular methyl parhydroxybenzoate (E218) or propyl (E216)
12. Treatment with Deferoxamine
13. Known kidney stones within the past 1 year
